note: Only the device types and attributes the firmware actually implements are listed here. Each attribute declares the device type ids it belongs to (deviceTypes) and whether it is mandatory for those types. The wizard only offers an attribute for mapping when one of its deviceTypes is selected on the endpoint, and auto-adds mandatory attributes when a device type is checked. Keep this in sync with firmware/main/matter_manager.cpp (add_device_clusters) and modbus_manager.cpp.

deviceTypes.name: Solar Power
deviceTypes.description: The physical inverter / solar power device. Use this on the root endpoint.

deviceTypes.name: Electrical Sensor
deviceTypes.description: Voltage / current / power measurement for one circuit (e.g. a PV string or the battery).

deviceTypes.name: Power Source
deviceTypes.description: Battery / power source. Adds state-of-charge (BatPercentRemaining). Pair with Electrical Sensor on a battery part.
